They first checked the family savings balance against the repair quote (8,000 yuan) and realized that finances were tight—the repair would deplete their emergency fund. Later, they convened a formal meeting in the living room, where Lu Mingqiang shared all the information and suggestions he had gathered during the day from neighbors, coworkers, and his brother-in-law. The two carefully calculated essential expenses for the next six months. After nearly an hour of weighing options and discussion, they finally reached a difficult consensus: to forgo the repair and proceed with scrapping the vehicle to recover its residual value; to rely primarily on electric bikes and public transportation for daily commutes, with car rentals or ride-hailing for longer trips; and to start keeping an eye out for affordable used cars without feeling pressured to buy one immediately. After making the decision, both felt a mix of emotions. They took a moment to calm down before settling the children to bed.

Without it, I can't get to work, pick up Hanhan, or handle emergencies at home. If we scrap it and buy a new one, we simply don’t have the money right now." Wang Lijuan remained silent for a moment before taking his hand and saying, "If you’ve made up your mind, we’ll follow your lead."

Lu Mingqiang took it, his fingers tracing the cover of the passbook. His Adam's apple bobbed. "We'll withdraw eight thousand first to pay for the car repairs. The rest... we'll leave untouched, just in case there are other expenses." The elder son, Lu Zixuan, listened with only partial understanding, while the younger one, Lu Zihan, clamored for his father to take him along.

Dad is going to take it to the doctor today, and we'll bring it home soon." The wallet instantly felt heavy, but a part of his heart felt hollow.

Without saying much, Lu Mingqiang directly pulled out 8,000 yuan in cash: "Master, here's the money. Please make sure the repairs are solid so it can last a few more years." The old mechanic counted the money, wrote out a receipt, and promised the car would be ready in three days. Looking at his beloved car, Lu Mingqiang felt a mix of emotions, but the sense of relief from having "solved the problem" slightly eased the pain of spending the money.

description: In the stuffy power distribution room, he met up with his coworker Chen Jianguo, who had arrived earlier. Lu Mingqiang first used a multimeter to measure the incoming line voltage and load-side resistance. Combining his observations with feedback from residents, he quickly determined that the cause of the fault was the sudden surge in load due to the concentrated use of high-power appliances like air conditioners during the summer, which exceeded the capacity of the old circuit breaker and caused it to burn out. He clearly explained the cause of the fault and the replacement steps to Chen Jianguo, emphasizing the safety procedures such as cutting off the upstream power, testing for electricity, and hanging warning signs. He then stood at a safe distance, closely monitoring every step of Chen Jianguo's operation (disassembly, cleaning, installation, and tightening) and continuously reminding him of key safety points. After the replacement was completed, he personally double-checked the wiring and directed the closing of the circuit to restore power, gradually bringing the building's lights back on. Once the emergency repair was finished, he immediately called Team Leader Zhang to report the cause of the fault, the handling process, and the outcome. He then helped Chen Jianguo pack up the tools. Chen Jianguo inquired with concern about Lu Mingqiang's back injury, to which Lu Mingqiang replied that he was managing with the support of a back brace, mainly focusing on directing with words and observation, and thanked Chen Jianguo for his hard work. After a brief exchange, the two went their separate ways.

After replacing the new circuit breaker, they spent an additional half-hour as a precautionary measure to tighten and inspect all wiring terminals in the circuit and tested the insulation of adjacent circuits to ensure no hidden risks remained. Using the segmented power-on isolation method, the issue was precisely traced to a high contact resistance at an aluminum oxide wire joint in the vertical shaft on the 5th floor of Block 3. I instructed apprentice Zhao Qiang to replace the joint using a copper lug and a hydraulic crimping tool, and allowed him to independently complete the insulation wrapping. The fault was successfully resolved, and all electricity meter readings returned to normal.

name: Emergency Repair Task
description:
As the workday was nearing its end, I began packing up my personal belongings to pick up my younger son. Suddenly, I received an urgent call from an old client, Mr. Li, who reported that the main circuit breaker in his shop had tripped. Every time he tried to reset it, it would trip again immediately, leaving appliances like refrigerators unusable. He was understandably very anxious. I immediately assured him that I would come over right away and quickly gathered the necessary repair tools and materials. Driving my private car, I navigated through the evening rush hour traffic to reach Mr. Li’s shop.

Upon arrival, I first calmed the client’s nerves before promptly opening the distribution box and using a multimeter to troubleshoot the circuits section by section. Eventually, I identified the root cause: a lighting circuit leading to the back storage room had developed a ground short circuit due to moisture damaging the insulation. Skillfully, I switched off the branch circuit, stripped the damaged cable, replaced it with a new section of wire, and ensured proper insulation and waterproofing. During the process, the cramped space and the tangled, aging wiring posed a slight challenge, but I took a deep breath, stayed calm, and relied on my experience to resolve the issue smoothly.

After restoring power, all circuits returned to normal operation. Mr. Li expressed his gratitude repeatedly and insisted on paying according to the emergency repair rate.
location: At the distribution box inside the Li's Appliance Repair Shop, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

My wife expressed understanding and support, while the children curiously asked questions about electricity. After dinner, I checked my eldest son Zixuan’s weekend homework and helped him solve a math problem. Then, I spent ten minutes playing with building blocks with my younger son Zihan. In the study, I turned on the computer, logged into a technical forum, and carefully drafted a reply to the factory supervisor, incorporating the ideas discussed with Chen Jianguo during the day. The content mainly included: thanking him for his attention, briefly introducing my professional background and local project experience, expressing interest in further exploring potential collaboration, and suggesting a phone call for discussion. I revised it several times, striving for professionalism and sincerity, but did not send it immediately. Stepping out of the study, I saw my wife tidying up in the living room. We sat down and chatted for a while, talking about the good results of the mock exam and the suggestions from my coworkers. My wife was happy for me and reminded me not to overwork myself. The simple conversation completely eased the emotional fluctuations from the day’s emergency repairs, leaving me feeling grounded and warm.

description: Enjoying breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and younger son Lu Zihan, which included white porridge, fried eggs, meat buns, and pickled vegetables. The children chattered about school activities while his wife reminded them to eat slowly. The atmosphere was warm and cozy, marking the family's final breakfast at home in 2025.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, home dining room

name: Send the children to school.
date: From 07:30:00 on December 31, 2025 to 07:53:00 on December 31, 2025
description: Driving his own SUV, he first took his younger son Lu Zihan to Longhua District Central Kindergarten, which took about 8 minutes, and handed him over to the teacher at the entrance. Then, he drove his elder son Lu Zixuan to Meilan Experimental Primary School, which was a bit farther, taking about 15 minutes. On the way, Lu Zixuan mentioned that school might end early in the afternoon, and Lu Mingqiang reminded him to be careful.
location: From home to the entrance of Longhua District Central Kindergarten at No. 6 Youyi Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and then to the entrance of Meilan Experimental Primary School at No. 1 Bailong North Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning jogging exercise
description: After dropping off the children, I went for a 15-minute jog along the internal roads and small gardens of the residential area to stretch my muscles and shift my mindset into work mode. The morning air was fresh, and I encountered Uncle Wang, a neighbor who was also exercising. We exchanged nods in greeting.
location: Internal roads and small gardens within the Longhua Court Residential Community, Jinyu East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Commuting to work by car
date: From 08:10:00 on December 31, 2025 to 08:25:00 on December 31, 2025
description: After finishing the jog, I quickly took a shower at home, changed into my work clothes, grabbed my commuter bag, and drove from home to the office. The morning rush hour had already passed, so the roads were clear, and I arrived at the underground parking lot of Nanguang Center Office Building in about 15 minutes.
location: From the Longhua Court Residential Community, Jinyu East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the Nanguang Center Office Building, No. 1 Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Arrive at the company and start the workday.
description: Arriving at the company team office, I first brew a cup of strong tea, tidy up my personal locker and toolbox. I greet my colleague Chen Jianguo, and Team Leader Zhang informs us of a meeting at 9 o'clock. The office atmosphere is more relaxed than usual, with everyone chatting about their plans for tonight's New Year's Eve celebration.
location: No. 1, Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Nanguang Center Office Building, Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd. Team Office

name: Company Year-End Meeting and Skills Recognition
description: Attend the brief year-end team meeting to summarize the safety work of the year and emphasize precautions for holiday duty. Manager Liu delivered a year-end speech, specifically commending Lu Mingqiang for obtaining the senior technician certificate this year and presenting him with a "Skill Improvement Award" red envelope. Lu Mingqiang accepted the recognition amidst applause, nodding in gratitude to everyone.
location: No. 1, Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Nanguang Center Office Building, Company Small Conference Room

name: Squad Internal Affairs Arrangement and Tool Maintenance
description: After the meeting, we conducted the year-end cleaning and centralized maintenance of tools. I partnered with Chen Jianguo to clean and maintain the public equipment. During this time, Chen Jianguo joked about the red envelope, and Lu Mingqiang smiled and agreed to treat everyone another day. During the work break, I carefully put away the red envelope, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: No. 1 Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Nanguang Center Office Building, Company Team Office, Public Rest Area

name: Walking to lunch with colleagues.
description: Along with fellow workers like Chen Jianguo, they walked about 12 minutes to their usual haunt, the "Old Place" street food stall. For lunch, they ordered grilled fish, stir-fried clams, a small stir-fry, and beer, with Lu Mingqiang opting for tea instead of alcohol. As they ate, they chatted, reminiscing about the tough battles they had fought over the past year, sharing amusing anecdotes from work, and talking about their families, all in a particularly relaxed atmosphere.
location: Walk from the Nanguang Center office building to the "Old Place" food stall at No. 24 Xiangrong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and dine at the food stall.

name: Return to the company for lunch break and wait to get off work.
description: After lunch, I took a walk back to the company, which took about 12 minutes to aid digestion. Upon returning to the office, some of my colleagues took a short nap, but Lu Mingqiang wasn’t sleepy. He quietly browsed through the photos in the "2025 Highlights" album on his phone. The afternoon was mostly uneventful. Around 2:50 PM, Team Leader Zhang announced an early end to the workday. Lu Mingqiang checked his assigned area and put the tools back in their places.
location: Return from Xiangrong Road Food Stalls to the Nanguang Center Office Building at No. 1 Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and proceed to the company team office.

name: Shopping on the way home by car and picking flowers in the neighborhood.
description: Driving home from the company with a light heart, I stopped at the Ririlong convenience store on the way to buy coconut juice, cola, snacks that the kids love, and local green jujubes that my wife enjoys. I decided against buying roses and instead chose to pick flowers in the neighborhood. After parking at home, I went to the small garden and selected a few of the most vibrant red bougainvillea branches to arrange in the vase in the living room.
location: Driving from the company to home, passing by the Ririlong Grocery Store on Jinyu East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and finally arriving at the small garden in the residential area of the Longhua Court.

name: Create an annual family electronic photo album
description: After returning home, I put away the drinks and snacks, and placed the bougainvillea in a vase filled with water at the center of the dining table. In the study, I focused on creating a digital photo album, importing over fifty carefully selected photos, arranging them in chronological order, and adding a piano piece my wife loves. I also included subtitles that read "Our 2025" and "Happy New Year." I repeatedly previewed and adjusted the album, dedicating myself to the task with great care and attention.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, Home Study

name: Pick up the children from school and bring them home.
description: After completing the initial work on the photo album, I went out to pick up the children. First, I picked up Lu Zixuan from Meilan Experimental Primary School, then went to the kindergarten to get Lu Zihan. As soon as the kids got in the car, they chattered away, sharing stories from their last day of school. Lu Mingqiang responded with a smile as he drove back home.
location: Starting from home, passing by Meilan Experimental Primary School at No. 1 Bailong North Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Longhua District Central Kindergarten at No. 6 Youyi Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and finally returning home.

name: Preparing and Enjoying the New Year's Eve Family Dinner
description: After returning home, I helped my wife Wang Lijuan prepare dinner, which included Hainanese chicken rice, boiled shrimp, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, lotus root and pork rib soup, and jujubes. The whole family gathered around the table, with Lu Mingqiang serving his wife dishes and praising her cooking skills. The children eagerly shared stories from school, filling the dining room with laughter and joy.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, kitchen and dining room at home

name: Cleaning up after meals and reviewing family videos.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to clear the dishes, while his wife wiped the table. During their break, Lu Mingqiang brought out snacks for the children and quietly told his wife that he had prepared a "little something" for them to watch together. He then projected the electronic photo album he had made onto the television, and the whole family watched the photos together, including the Spring Festival family portrait, work scenes, and family moments. Wang Lijuan’s eyes grew moist, the children excitedly pointed and identified the photos, and Lu Mingqiang held his wife close, creating a strong emotional resonance.
location: Longhua Court Residential Community, Jinyu East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, in the kitchen and living room at home.

name: Family free activities and watching the New Year's Eve gala
description: After the photo album was played, the children played with toys in the living room, while Lu Mingqiang and his wife chatted softly while watching the New Year's Eve TV gala, reminiscing about the year's little moments. Lu Mingqiang handed his wife the "Skill Enhancement Award" red envelope he received from the company, and she happily accepted it. Their youngest son, Lu Zihan, was coaxed to sleep around 9 p.m.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, living room and bedroom at home

name: New Year Countdown and Rehabilitation Stretching Exercises
description: The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, insisted on waiting for the countdown. As it approached midnight, the whole family softly counted along with the voices on the television: "5, 4, 3, 2, 1... Happy New Year!" The faint sound of distant fireworks could be heard outside the window. Lu Mingqiang and his wife exchanged a smile, wishing each other a Happy New Year. After the countdown, Lu Zixuan went to sleep, while Lu Mingqiang completed his daily 15-minute waist rehabilitation stretching exercises.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, living room at home

name: Washing up and going to bed marks the end of the day.
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom to find his wife already lying down. He gently got into bed, turned off the light, and whispered to her in the darkness, "You've worked hard this year. Next year will be better." His wife squeezed his hand. On the first tranquil night of 2026, they drifted into a deep sleep, weary yet warmed by the moment.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinyu East Road, Longhua Court Residential Community, in the bathroom and bedroom at home.
